places: Founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK)

fields.climate: temperate, with rainfall concentrated in summer; long, bitter winters
fields.terrain: mostly hills and mountains separated by deep, narrow valleys; wide coastal plains in west, discontinuous in east
fields.hazards: late spring droughts often followed by severe flooding; occasional typhoons during the early fall; volcanism: P'aektu-san (2,744 m) (also known as Baitoushan, Baegdu, or Changbaishan), on the Chinese border, is considered historically active
fields.resources: coal, iron ore, limestone, magnesite, graphite, copper, zinc, lead, precious metals, hydropower
fields.farm: maize, vegetables, rice, apples, cabbages, fruits, sweet potatoes, potatoes, beans, soybeans
fields.exports: fake hair, iron alloys, tungsten ore, electricity, cars
fields.industries: military products; machine building, electric power, chemicals; mining (coal, iron ore, limestone, magnesite, graphite, copper, zinc, lead, and precious metals), metallurgy…
fields.religions: traditionally Buddhist and Confucian, some Christian and syncretic Chondogyo (Religion of the Heavenly Way)
fields.legal: civil law system based on the Prussian model; influenced by Japanese traditions and Communist legal theory
fields.suffrage: 17 years of age; universal and compulsory

holiday.name: Founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK)

fields.military: compulsory military service for men (17-30 years of age) and women (17-23 years of age); service obligation is reportedly up to 10 years for men and up to 7 years for women
